intention: A user can save a manual charge record as IN PROGRESS with partial data and complete it later, leave energy and price blank (energy derived from the battery delta, price defaulting to 0), record the odometer, and review entries through a date filter with aggregation tiles and an at-a-glance completeness indicator.
request: Source ticket: MAG-18 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-18/adding-status-to-manual-records | Adding Status to Manual Records. Required fields: make energy_added_kwh and price optional (price empty => 0, no negatives); add a status dropdown (IN PROGRESS / DONE, i18n, stored as IN_PROGRESS/DONE) at the top of the section, persisted and loaded; existing required validations apply only when status is DONE; IN PROGRESS is the default and skips required validation for Ended at and End battery %, with logic easy to maintain for adding more fields later; remove Currency from the required section and label price as COP; syncing start/end date with the selected day. Optional fields: AC/DC helper labels; new optional odometer field. Your entries section: date filter (last 7 days default, this month), aggregation tiles (sessions, energy, cost, avg kWh/session) above the table, a Status column with a green/yellow circle next to Date, a start->end battery percentage column, remove the vehicle column, render empty fields as --, remove the refresh action. Saving: derive energy as capacity * ((end_battery - start_battery)/100) when blank, capacity 62 kWh behind a function pending a future DB/module read, with a KB note; only clear the form on HTTP 200.

decisions.decision: Record energy provenance via a new energy_source column; leave MAG-25's generated inferred_capacity_kwh_calc untouched
decisions.why: Derived energy makes inferred capacity echo the seed constant; the planned averaging feature would stop converging. Provenance cannot be reconstructed later.

decisions.decision: Backfill existing rows' status to IN_PROGRESS rather than DONE
decisions.why: User chose it over the leader's DONE recommendation, accepting that historical rows render unfinished as a prompt to re-check them.

decisions.decision: Unit and integration tests are INCLUDED in every tier
decisions.why: Overrides the owner's standing no-tests default; internal/charging already has DB-backed integration tests asserting against this table.

decisions.decision: Three tiers: charging schema/domain, then gateway form and gateway dashboard independently
decisions.why: Both gateway tiers depend only on tier 1 and touch disjoint template files, so neither blocks the other.

decisions.decision: Tier 2 covers BOTH charge_create_form.templ and charge_row_edit.templ with the full treatment
decisions.why: The inline edit row is the only UI that can move a record IN_PROGRESS -> DONE, the ticket's headline flow; the roadmap's file list omitted it.

decisions.decision: A client-side JS listener on the status select toggles `required` on D5's skip-set fields; no htmx round-trip
decisions.why: Instant feedback, native browser validation, consistent with D12's client-side date sync and D10's no-round-trip rule. RequiredFieldsFor stays the server-side gate.

decisions.decision: The odometer input renders inside the 'More details' collapsed section
decisions.why: Matches the ticket's own 'Optional fields' grouping and keeps the main card to fields filled every time.

decisions.decision: The disabled Currency input is REMOVED from both forms; the COP suffix inside the price input replaces it
decisions.why: Resolves D7's ambiguity toward the ticket's literal request. Pure UI removal: parseChargeForm already hardcodes COP and the column keeps its NOT NULL DEFAULT.

decisions.decision: With no vehicle resolved (teslaID==0) the page renders the empty state — no tiles, no table, no filter; the ListEntriesByAccount fallback is dropped
decisions.why: ListEntriesByVehicleBetween is vehicle-scoped and D13 forbids a new port. Only reachable for an account with zero vehicles, which cannot create entries either.

decisions.decision: The date filter mirrors superchargerMonthsSelector: server-built absolute ?start=&end= hrefs on ui.Join'd preset buttons, hx-get /ui/charges/list, hx-target #charges-list. 'This month' is the full calendar month
decisions.why: Reuses the gateway's existing date-filter vocabulary instead of adding a second idiom; accepts the same stale-window-past-midnight tradeoff superchargers already has.

decisions.decision: The active start/end window is threaded through the create form and each edit row so post-write OOB refreshes stay on the user's window
decisions.why: Otherwise a save silently resets 'this month' to 'last 7 days' and an out-of-window entry appears to vanish. Mirrors supercharger_row's windowStartStr/windowEndStr threading.

decisions.decision: The completeness dot is two-state: green when complete, yellow otherwise
decisions.why: What the ticket asked for; the adjacent status badge already distinguishes IN_PROGRESS from DONE, so a third colour would duplicate it.
